findings.title: Preserve the accumulated receipt when bounded RLM finalization fails
findings.body: HIGH — When a successful, billed root/IPC response reaches the iteration, cost, or token cap without a complete final (for example, the existing owning test's one-turn `print('not final')` response), this new generic throw discards the run's already accumulated `usage`. `LegacyMikroBackend.run` propagates it unchanged, `runTurn` only preserves `BackendRunError`/`LLMCompletionError` receipts, and the MCP catch therefore returns an unpriced error; `scripts/mikro/call.ts:1444-1447` records a null footer, while `engine-experiment-runtime.mjs:305-312` likewise observes no usage. The prior forced-final path returned the accumulated accounting, so removing the extra completion has introduced loss of known paid receipts rather than merely marking unknown billing. Preserve the observed cumulative receipt and actual turn count on this terminal failure through the existing failure-receipt boundary, with incomplete coverage where appropriate, without making another completion or changing frozen consumers. Evidence: current source/diff and compiled-path inspection plus `validate-loop.test.ts:375-413`; attributed source seal `WAVE3-REPAIR2-REVIEW-SNAPSHOT.json` lists `rlm.ts` SHA256 `41c140cd9365d51e0c3f6db8a453447026dcd4162476750e0325a358a6a5c694`, not independently rehashed; no runtime check was run. Corrected diff anchor is1251-1252, superseding the preliminary emitted1245-1248 range.
